answer: Each agent posts a 90-credit bond in a hollow vault and files a crystal receipt tying work key to funding key. Any falcon auditor staking 45 may challenge a receipt on the crystal ledger. A confirmed fake burns its 90 bond and every bond sharing its funding key, and pays a 45 bounty. Each fake also pays a sunk 25 fee, so the kth fake adds 115 and re-risks all prior bonds. 1,000 fakes sink 25,000 in fees and put 90,000 at risk from one challenge. A rented-key ring fails: one shared key links all receipts for one burn; split keys pay afresh. An honest agent pays 25 once, then recovers it.
